text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *huff, puff, pant*... I did it. However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You were right, Trainer! That shining 
late-race kick was...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a fiercely fought battle! Seeking the 
Pearl ran just as brilliantly as her 
reputation promised. Andâ

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright delivers a performance far 
exceeding expectations! The ferocity of 
her late charge was on a completely 
different level from anything we've seen 
before!

The prediction hit the mark. Mejiro Bright 
showed running completely unlike anything 
seen from her before, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, therapist... Just what kind of magic 
did you use?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright's legs are weak, so she shouldn't 
be able to run like that yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Therapist
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't used any magic. Bright's legs 
simply developed naturally. However—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Therapist
text_block_list.text:
"I've prepared thoroughly so that whenever 
I hit my stride, I'd be ready. That's why 
I can run this fast already."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I see. Then I'll also...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Therapist
text_block_list.text:
Yes, naturally we analyze them the same 
way and devise the optimal training 
regimen. For us—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Therapist
text_block_list.text:
Because we possess "knowledge." Knowledge 
that has been accumulated within the 
Mejiro family over many years.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Glad you're here. I need to 
consult with you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hello, Pearl-san.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ――!? Dober...

The one who appeared was Mejiro Dober, the 
cool beauty of the Mejiro family with high 
expectations for her future.

—"The Mejiros are nothing to fear." 
Seeking the Pearl's face, having just said 
that, twitched ever so slightly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl-san, I'm up after Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright ran a great race today. And she 
gave me a hint.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I will surpass you, Pearl-san. 
—As a member of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: As the Mejiro... family...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What a terrifying family. No matter how 
many times I brush them off, yet another 
challenger appears...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"But I cannot run away. Not when I am 
someone who will soon show the world our 
potential."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Where's the best stage for 
the Junior-class showdown!?

Even backed into a corner, Seeking the 
Pearl asks for my opinion. Naturally, next 
up is a GⅠ.

Distance-wise, the mile races—the Hanshin 
JF or the Asahi Hai FS. And if we look 
toward the Triple Tiara route—
choice_data_list: I think the "Hanshin JF" is the way to go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin JF... Yeah, a mile race might 
be easier for me to run too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So in one month, then. Got it. Does that 
work for you too, Pearl-san?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course it's fine. Anywhere is fine 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have you, that's all that 
matters. Isn't that right, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Danger!! It's danger, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate... she's gonna get the best 
of me. That Dober, I mean."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I underestimated the power of the 
Family. One of the powerhouse factions 
reigning over the Umamusume world...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I thought they were just an ordinary 
herd, but I realized today. Without 
knowing the true nature of that power, 
it's dangerous."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, we probably won't be able 
to stand against them. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Detective! Investigation time! Let's spend 
this month uncovering everything we can. 
What does it truly mean to be an Umamusume 
family?

An Umamusume family. Of course, I was 
aware that such a concept existed. But...

"Without a deeper understanding, one could 
easily get tripped up in the Hanshin JF. 
Seeking the Pearl seemed to think so."
